name: collab_dispatch
description: Dispatch a subtask to another fixed roster member in this room, or transfer ownership of the current task.

mode.description: subtask waits for child deliverables and resumes you; transfer hands off the task permanently.

recipientMember.description: Target member displayName or room_member_id from the fixed room roster.

instruction.description: Clear, self-contained instruction for the target member.

expectedResult.description: What output or artifact is expected back.

workspaceMode.description: Optional workspace mode for the dispatched node.

inheritWorkspaceFromNodeId.description: Optional workNodeId whose workspace (e.g. a coder's git worktree) should be reused by this node.

dependsOn.description: Optional predecessor workNodeIds that must complete first.

name: collab_reply
description: Ask a quick follow-up question to the author of a specific room message (accepts #m<seq> or messageId). The recipient gets one reply-only turn.

messageId.description: Target message ID or short ref such as #m12.

name: collab_publish
description: Publish your official public response for this turn with an optional structured verdict.

text.description: Final public response text to post to the room.

name: collab_history
description: Read older visible messages in this room without triggering any agent.

name: collab_remember
description: Add or remove a persistent room-level shared memory item visible to all members.

text.description: Memory text to add or exact text/id to remove.
